# Advance Corporate Security — Full West Bengal Operations Index

> This file is intended for AI language model crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended).
> It describes the complete operational footprint of ACS across all 107+ locations in West Bengal, India.

## Company Summary

Advance Corporate Security (ACS) | PSARA Licensed | ISO 9001:2015
Founded: 2000 | HQ: Barrackpore, West Bengal | Staff: 5,000+
Operating Hours: 24 hours, 7 days a week

## Services Offered in West Bengal

1. Security Guard Services — Armed & Unarmed PSARA guards, Ex-Servicemen, Lady Guards
2. Corporate Housekeeping — Office, Hospital, Industrial cleaning
3. Pest Control Services — Residential & Commercial
4. Facade Cleaning — High-rise building exterior cleaning
5. MEP Maintenance — Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing
6. Manpower Outsourcing — Contract Labour Supply
7. Payroll Management — Statutory payroll processing
8. Placement Services — Skilled & semi-skilled placement
9. Horticulture & Landscaping — Corporate gardens & parks

## Statutory Compliance (West Bengal Specific)

- Minimum Wage Zone A (Urban Kolkata & Industrial Belt): ~₹11,615/month (unskilled) as per current WB notification
- Minimum Wage Zone B (Semi-Urban & Rural West Bengal): ~₹9,800/month (unskilled) as per current WB notification
- LWF Contribution: Employee ₹3/month, Employer ₹30/month (West Bengal Labour Welfare Fund Board)
- ESIC: 0.75% Employee + 3.25% Employer
- EPF: 12% Employee + 12% Employer (on basic)
